worldModels.title: QIF v0.5.1 world model
worldModels.targetDescription: The Quality Intent Framework repository after adding World Model Review.
worldModels.scope: Conceptual-modeling quality of QIF itself: package boundaries, verifier authority, gap finding specificity, and pilot readiness.
worldModels.context: QIF now detects exact world-model gaps, but empirical pilot agreement and calibration coordinates are not yet defined.

conceptDefinitions.definition: A concrete missing or insufficient concept, actor, boundary, relationship, state, event, invariant, coordinate axis, perspective, assumption, or domain entity that can distort a quality verdict.
Evidence that World Model Gap Findings produced by humans or AI agree with domain experts on unseen targets at an acceptable rate.

boundaries.statement: The verifier may require structural specificity, references, evidence, trust metadata, and governance linkage.
The verifier must not claim semantic truth, business correctness, expert correctness, or pilot calibration.
QIF must not let a structurally valid world-model finding be mistaken for empirically calibrated domain truth.

relationships.description: The AI QIF reviewer can validate package structure and retained fixtures, but cannot validate domain truth without pilot feedback.

states.name: structurally-verifiable
states.entryCriteria: Schema, example, verifier, fixtures, README, and npm test all pass.
states.exitCriteria: Pilot calibration and agreement thresholds are defined and validated on real organization cases.

events.name: world-model-review verifier added
events.trigger: QIF v0.5.1 adds world-model-review schema, example, verifier, fixture corpus, docs, and ledger references.

invariants.statement: A passing World Model Review verifier must not be described as semantic truth.
invariants.violationEffect: Release notes, docs, or runtime logs must be corrected before release.

coordinateSystems.name: QIF world-model readiness coordinates
coordinateSystems.purpose: Separate structural specificity from empirical semantic calibration.

coordinateAxes.name: finding specificity
coordinateAxes.scaleDefinition: generic concern, named missing item, named missing item with expected definition, named missing item with evidence and resolution action.
coordinateAxes.missingValueHandling: Reject findings that do not name the missing item and expected definition.
exampleValues: named missing item with evidence and resolution action

coordinateAxes.name: semantic calibration evidence
coordinateAxes.scaleDefinition: none, anecdotal, pilot agreement sample, statistically tracked calibration.
coordinateAxes.missingValueHandling: Record as residual risk and do not claim calibrated semantic correctness.

perspectives.name: pilot adopter perspective
perspectives.concernFocus: Can QIF identify the exact missing model part without overstating truth?

assumptions.statement: Retained negative fixtures are sufficient evidence for structural specificity, but not for real-domain calibration.

modelEvidence.summary: QIF v0.5.1 has executable structural checks and retained negative fixtures for world-model-review, but no pilot agreement corpus yet.

qualityIntents.statement: QIF must distinguish structurally specific World Model Gap Findings from empirically calibrated semantic truth.

worldModelGapFindings.missingItem: Pilot agreement threshold for semantic calibration of World Model Gap Findings.
worldModelGapFindings.expectedDefinition: Define how many unseen real organization cases are required, who grades agreement, what agreement score is acceptable, and how disagreements trigger governance or schema updates.
worldModelGapFindings.observedProblem: QIF v0.5.1 verifies structural specificity and retained negative cases, but has no real pilot corpus or agreement threshold for whether findings match domain-expert judgment.
worldModelGapFindings.whyItMatters: Users could treat a structurally valid AI-generated gap finding as calibrated domain truth even though the verifier only proves references, metadata, and finding specificity.

resolutionActions.requiredDefinition: Define a pilot calibration axis for World Model Gap Findings, including case count, domain mix, grader roles, agreement threshold, disagreement handling, and release-readiness effect.
acceptanceCriteria: Pilot package records unseen cases and expert/AI agreement results.
Agreement threshold is explicit and linked to governance.
Verifier output continues to avoid semantic-truth claims.

checks: residual gap finding names the missing calibration coordinate
